$comment: The rooms gate's per-rule ratchet (#1015, Wave 4). It may only ever go DOWN: a rule above its max fails `bun run lint:product`, a rule under it prints the number to lower it to, and a rule absent here is at ZERO. Each entry names the wave that clears it. Re-measured on lane/1015-kit after merging APPS-A and APPS-B Wave 3; run `node scripts/lint-mobile-rooms.mjs` to re-measure. `back-literal`, `identity-tint`, `copy-title-case` and `error-detail` reached zero and are gone from this file, which makes them unconditional (`error-detail` by the R-A-15 sweep, #1015).
